I just used the option to free up space and now the app it's just a mess of unorganized photos sorted by date only. I'd like to have the option to at least create albums that automatically fill with pics from a certain device folder so I don't have to deal with this mess. I like my photos organized by decice folder but albums olny let me fill them automatically with photos of certain people or pets.

This is just poor and i can't believe i thought this was the answer to my problems, far from it! Sync doesn't work, just hangs with the following messages: - getting photos OR - getting ready to backup Also, app doesn't find my photo folders half the time. tried everything from a reinstall to clear data/cache but nothing works. sharing? pointless if i can't get my photos in the cloud to begin with and seems like Google don't care from a lot of what I've read about others having similar issues.

This app used to be really good and helpful with storing all my photos, and I quite liked the "on this day" bit back in time. But now with the stupid "remember this day" and it was like two days ago, er of course I remember that day! For me it chooses to show me what happened a few days ago or earlier this month, I don't need to see that, I took the photos I should remember it! The old app with the previous years was better, please consider taking it back to the easier simple version.

Great app! Very easy to synchronize between cell phone and laptop. I value how this app organizes photos for you based on location, features (e.g. mountains, lakes and cities), allows you to bulk-rotate photos and offers easily stylized photos. You can also create shared albums. Perhaps the most important feature is the free storage. I highly reccomend this app.

I love Google Photos. Apart from being able to store and access my photos from different devices, I have to say that the photo editing tools are just great. It's unbelievable some of the edits that can come out from the basic editing tools. 👌👌Really like the additional features it's been bringing such as the highlights and the photo map. I like using the vignette feature but not being able to apply it to other margins if the focus falls on one side can be a downside.

It used to be THE app I advised everyone to install, but for now, with that upload limit and paywall, you're far better off buying yourself a couple of usb keys or external SSD.. I get storage is expensive and upload would have keep increasing, but going from unlimited free to that is a huge drop. Maybe someday they'll increase the free storage or something, but at least, until then, it could give the opportunity for other cloud providers to get more people and offer better deals.

Usually good, but every update breaks it more. After editing photos, either with the markup tool or by cropping them, I can't save the changes. The "done" button exists, but nothing happens when you press it. Can't uninstall/reinstall as it's a system app. Tried force stopping it and clearing the cache. Nope. It keeps saying it has stopped working and I can't even upload or download pictures, documents and videos. Sometimes I will download a picture or video and just about minutes after viewing, the video can't play and the pictures are blurred. It is a very useless and irritating app, I try to uninstall it but it is just there. Google can't answer when I send a complaint.

This app is not trustworthy. Failing to upload pictures and albums and a very messy gallery. Rarely the actual date of the picture is the same as the date on the gallery, finding myself looking around all the gallery for what I'm looking for. This app is usually pretty good, but recent updates have hidden a lot of my favourite features away without a way to access them. Now, if I dismiss a notification for an automatic creation, I'll probably never find it again.

I'm really enjoying the app, it's amazing. I just have a suggestion, if you guys can modify so I can browse my backed up photos in folders, just as I backed it up! If you can include it as an option apart from grouping the pictures. This will really save a lot of time I spend searching for a particular picture in the past. Great job guys!!

Downloading this app was a necessary evil at the time. And while G made it easy to get my photos to the app, It's very difficult to get them back to my phone in bulk. I sent G an email letting them know and asking for help but no one ever responded. Other complaints... Pictures that were in folders on my phone are now scattered throughout the app by date. Also... a bigger problem... MISSING PICTURES! I ordered a laptop with a huge memory so I don't have to deal with this anymore!

This is probably the only app I'll give 5 stars. First off, it's such a valuable free service, so much online storage of photos both for archival purposes and sharing. The ability to auto backup my photos is great, if anything catastrophic happens I'm not totally pooched. The interface is intuitive and works how you'd expect it. The face organization is borderline creepy, but super handy when I want to find a certain image. Really not much to complain about. No alternative comes close.

Pros: Almost everything. Cons: 1: While uploading photos it consumes quite a chunk of our batteries. 2: Since last update, Search bar and Library tab became more of an issue then solving matters. For older folks, it is really uncomfortable way of hard to find photos from different sources then Camera. Suggestion: Make a very hidden setting (as you usually do) where you can revent to old view.

I don't understand why you always turning the back up quality to "High Quality" even when I set that to "Original"...okay, my bad, It's time to delete some pictures because my Google drive is nearly full. But can you just stop backing up my pictures instead of changing the settings? Also how about having unlimited storage of Photos we make public??? Think about that.

Spend hours of my life trying to share albums in the past few months - it keeps returning error to try again later... At the same time the photos are syncing - the backed up photos from each device would appear on the other one. But the app isn't that useful without having the option to organize photos in albums that would sync across devices and that are shareable.

FFS what on earth have you done to this app?? It used to be amazing and with the last update it's become an absolute nightmare. It's backing up forever, and in the end it doesn't even back up. And for some reason it's changed all my pictures dates!! I know exactly when they've been taken and the app believes ot was in a completely different day. Awful. I'll swap to iPhone and use the cloud instead. Chau.

After using the app for a few months it's started to crash when editing a picture. It's now unusable as every other image crashes when saving an edited image. You have to close the app, force stop it and then retry just for it to happen again a couple of pictures later. I've come here to delete the app and have noticed an updated version so will give it a go. It's a shame as it's a nice and easy app that did the job perfectly.

Unlimited storage is really awesome but it's uploading videos and pictures all the time over 3g even if settings are different. Also I don't understand how the settings are different all the time and blocked for me to change. The settings for backup show different on Google plus. Really weird. It's also draining my battery and I can never be sure if it's uploading or not.

I hate the complications of the app, the fact that it has folders and albums but not all of your photos are there. Folders show up on Instagram to upload but albums don't and neither does the rest of the photos unless you go through all of the options but then you can only pick 1. Unnecessarily awkward to use, it's the worst photo app I've ever had to use.

Ok, so you´ve got all the fancy new functions, photoalbums, Assistent and bla bla.. but it got too clever, too far, too automatic, too prone to human arbitration. Few really disturbing things:  1) Why the heck when you make an album (upload from PC, photos in the PC are put in PC from phone by cable) are the photos chaotically disordered? Edited 14/06/22: I read the article and did what it suggested. It has made no difference. I removed a star because the suggestion to do all those things to an app that's been working fine annoyed me. Photos have suddenly gone missing from the photos tab on pixel 7 pro after the last update. Update: No longer an issue as it turns out that I was logged into a different account. But I am giving a 4 star review still as I still see some pics only in one of the accounts, although the backup is turned off completely on all the accounts. It's a pain to alter files. Rename a file? Good luck. Taking a photo of a receipt, and you want to crop it, rotate it, rename it, and send it? Sometimes when you save your adjusted image, it seems to overwrite the file, sometimes it saves a copy in a mystery location in another folder elsewhere. Its really inconsistent.

This app is pretty good. Definitely, recommend it to friends and family. However, I do have a few gripes about it.   Why oh why, can we not download Albums for offline viewing on mobile devices? Its silly that Google can pick out my dogs face out of thousands of pictures, but can't save an album to the device for offline viewing.  Speaking of picking my dog out of my pictures, I have had this app for years, and an account as well, and the People and Pets section is still only People. Please fix!  So far those are the only issues I can say about it.  So many good things though. Removing photos from the device after confirming they are on the cloud, in order to free up space on the device. Picking my dog out of thousands of photo's is very impressive, even if I have to search for animals instead my dogs name. And last but not least, the assistant, puts together nice collages, memory videos, and automatic albums based on location and time periods.  Well made, with many convenient features. However still lacking a few important ones.

Great app for storing your many pictures. It is great at organising your pictures. It also gives you a history of photos you took on a significant date years ago which is very nostalgic. It's a great app to use and you will enjoy having your photos stored here. If you lose your device all you have to do is remember your Google account and password and you'll have access to your pictures again.

Very Good Application. No matter what device I'm using I can always access my photos and videos without the use of a memory card. The downside is that in order to access some files on photos I would have to be connected to the internet. Another issue is not all files are automatically backed up and if you do not manually backup those files you run the risk of losing those files.

The new UI.. a hit and miss. It's more difficult (albeit inexistent) to see the auto generated creations, stylized photos etc, and specially movies and albuns: I miss the "for you" tab (you need to go to a PC). Good addition the map fixture... But still I can't edit date and geo tag my photos... Also I like the new edit features. for now it's more like a backup app with pay fixtures than a photo app.

There are 2 issues: 1) when you delete a photo permanently from trash sometimes it comes back 2) when you free up space some of the photos can still be found locally, somehow it fails to delete them; however, I noticed that they are saved in cloud... I hope at least... Other than that, the app works pretty well now. Much better than it used to.

Couldn't help but need to comment for this time. The new update feels lacking the colors and the user friendliness that it used to have. Prefer the previous version over this newest update. Couldn't really find the share album, particularly the album that automatically shared by others that has certain people in the pictures. Still prefer the bigger thumbnail of the albums and more color-vibrant interface. The autogenerated highlight was not bad though.

Constant push notifications. Very needy app that constantly sends me notifications of pictures that have been backed up. No, I do not want a custom memory of the four work photos I took last Tuesday. Why do you think anyone wants this? Wish it would just quietly backup my photos as new phones have such limited internal storage. Not sure why I need to micro manage every apps push notification settings. It's becoming ridiculous.

there are many many bad qualities to this app but what I hated most was that it deleted 300 of my pictures to "free up space" and didn't give me the chance to choose which would be deleted. Of course I can still save back to my device but the quality of the picture isn't as great. Also the dates get messed up which makes the photo harder to find back as it wouldn't be in the same range as another photo that was taken on the same day.

I am giving one star because there is no room for zero star, bad experience , cant edit pictures. Used to be a great app. Was a bit annoyed that google removed the automatic backup as an option a while ago, but usually remembered to open & back up every few days or so, but following the last update I have about 30 photos not backed up and it's stuck on 'Getting ready to back up' and saying I have nearly 4000 photos to back up? Google photos does a great job of photo analysis. It can stitch together multiple photos to automatically create panoramic photos. It will make some "auto awesome" adjusts to some photos and ask if you like it to then save the new photo. Further to this, it will also automatically (usually) create an album if you travel and take photos. This is one of my favorite features. It usually chooses a subset of the best pictures and videos from your collection of photos taken while away and puts them all together in an album

I am really enjoying the app and I like the back up system. Fast and easy. I was able to save so many memories and be able to access them from any device. I am a little bit sad, since unlimited backup stopped and it's unnecessarily expensive. I would like to suggest that maybe you could give 15GB every year for free instead of unlimited. Either way I want to thank you for the app

Can't believe a software giant like Google is unable to make a good galley app. I admit that recent updates are making it faster but now it's a visual mess. It's showing all the useless folder that I don't want in my gallery such as video cache, app icons, empty file folders and there is no option to hide or ignore them. If any developer ever pays attention to the users then plz look into it.

Excellent app! I love how it creates animations, videos and collections on its own. I did a home project recently over the span of a couple weeks taking periodic pictures of the progress. A few days after the project was completed, I received a slideshow which pulled out only the pictures of the project. Awesome feature! It also creates then & now pictures if my kids and pulls together albums like "best of summer 2018" which are typically the pictures I would have chosen to pull into an album as well. To get a printed photo album out of the app is also possible, but pretty expensive. Overall, one of my favorite apps... although recently the automatic assistant creations have slowed in their frequency. Hopefully this feature improves as I do look forward to seeing what the app pulls together. It's both amazing and a little creepy at how well it does.

i have been using the app for years now, but a few weeks ago i got hit with the "unable to save changes" error, which makes editing photos or videos on my phone (OnePlus 7T) impossible. It is good and fast. . But I don't like the editing after the last update. The old editing was more intuitive and easy, please bring it back. . Another problem is that when creating a collage you can't arrange the photos the way you want, and I can't see why. . A suggestion: ad the option to add text to picture, so we don't need other editing apps.

I have been using this app for years and have historically been quite impressed with it BUT lately the amount of bugs is INCREASING at an alarming rate. Very frustrating! Also, when I upload a photo from another device, then choose to save the photo to my mobile device in the app, it duplicates the photo! Why?? It's the same photo! I really enjoyed using Google Photos, until the backup feature got stuck, with an endless loop of "Getting ready to back up". There's not a lot of information on what to do when this happens - I've tried force stopping the app, clearing the cache and clearing the data - it only made the problem worse with 1 photo stuck now being 62 photos stuck. For those who aren't technologically literate, this issue would be a nightmare to fix, and would break the back up feature. You would think for an app that you pay for (to buy storage), things would be better.

Great photo storage, managing, editing, viewing and sharing app. Only one thing could make it better... the ability to show only photos that you haven't added to your albums - so you can see which ones still don't have a 'home' - either as a fixed feature, or one that can be toggled on or off. This way, you'll know which photos have not been 'categorised'.

Free unlimited storage of high quality photos is a great thing in itself, but it's so much more. The auto creation of animations, panorama's, stylised photos etc. is fun, as well as being transported back to good old memories with 'Remember This Day'. It's also a reliable and simple way to create a shared album where everyone can put their photos from a particular event in the same place for all to enjoy!

It"s brilliant. The more you find out about it, the better it gets. Except for the lack of ability to sort Albums by anything other than date. Why on earth can't each photo be moved up or down the list, so you can arrange them exactly how you want them. This facility exists widely in other applications, why not in Google photos. Marking down a star because of this.

The positive, SD cards can & do fail so irreplaceable media like photos are always backed up. The negative. I'd prefer to have the option of deleting from the cloud only.
it's good but I think it would be great if you can play video in the background. (not in the app)

Major problem with zoom. After viewing photo with zoom it is highly likely to hang. The bug quite easily reproduced, just open photo zoom in, then zoom out, then go to next photo and repeat. I use Photos on a daily basis and see myself using it as long as I'm taking pictures, which will be the rest of my life. There are so many options that I still haven't used it to it's full potential. If you search for two people it will show you every picture that has at least one of those two people it it. I would love it if you could search exclusively for photos with both of those people in it. Like in a normal Google search when you put quotation marks around two or more words to get results that only contain both of those words. It would also be great if this applied to making a photo album based on people. Right now when you create a new album you can make one that adds all of your photos that include one or more people (and continues to automatically add photos of those people to the album as more photos of them are taken). It would be great if you could adjust the settings so that the album only adds photos that include both of these people. It seems like this would only require adding a new database query and a few additions to the front-end. I know you don't want to over complicate the app but I think that this feature would be so cool and useful that it would be worth adding. What couple wouldn't love to put in their names and find all the pictures of them together (without the pictures of each of them individually). Hope to see this in the app someday.
